8.5.2.4 Mixed type interpolation of integer curve
[SWS_Ifl_91001] Definition of API function Ifl_IpoCur_<InTypeMn>_f32
Upstream requirements: SRS_LIBS_00005, SRS_LIBS_00009, SRS_LIBS_00011
⌈
Service Name
Ifl_IpoCur_<InTypeMn>_f32
Syntax
float32 Ifl_IpoCur_<InTypeMn>_f32 (
const Ifl_DPResultF32_Type* dpResult,
const <InType>* Val_array
)
Service ID [hex]
0x13 to 0x16
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
dpResult
Data point search result
Parameters (in)
Val_array
Pointer to the result axis distribution array
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
float32
Result of the interpolation
Description
Based on searched indices and ratios information using the relevant Ifl_DPSearch_f32 routine,
this routine calculates and returns the interpolation result for a curve.
Available via
Ifl.h
⌋
[SWS_Ifl_00228] ⌈index=dpResult->Index
if dpResult->Ratio==0.0
Result=Val_array[index]
else
Result=Val_array[index] + (Val_array[index + 1]- Val_array[index]) * dpResult->Ratio⌋
